limits: WebKit on Windows is not physical iPhone Safari.
Checks cover named zones and captured states, not every notification combination.
Geographic pins can overlap at low zoom; Places provides separate large targets.
Activities are component layouts, not a manual story playthrough.
No physical-phone thermals, FPS guarantee, new Lighthouse score or field INP result.
Checks used a local production preview; deployment status is verified separately.
